name: Music
tip: Your music. Add base folders, then tap folders to browse and a track to play. Decoded in WebAssembly inside this wapp.

children.name: add_folder
children.label: Add folder
children.tip: Pick a base folder that holds your music.

children.name: music_home
children.label: Home
children.tip: Back to your base music folders.

children.name: mtree
children.empty: No music folders yet — tap Add folder.
children.tip: Tap a folder to open it, ".." to go up, or a track to play.

name: Films
tip: Your films. Add base folders, then browse and tap a film to play it.

children.name: add_film_folder
children.label: Add folder
children.tip: Pick a base folder that holds your films.

children.name: film_home
children.label: Home
children.tip: Back to your base film folders.

children.name: ftree
children.empty: No film folders yet — tap Add folder.
children.tip: Tap a folder to open it, ".." to go up, or a film to play.

name: Radio
tip: Online radio. Add stream URLs and tap to play.

children.name: add_station
children.label: Add station
children.tip: Add an online radio stream (name + URL).

children.name: stations
children.empty: No stations yet — tap Add station.
children.tip: Tap a station to play it; use a row's menu to remove it.

name: Video
tip: Video playback surface (opened automatically when a film plays).
